answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to lock a refundable stake before it may earn, like a pearl forming only after grit enters the shell: the stake is small for one honest agent but ruinous at scale, because to forge a thousand identities means locking a thousand stakes. Newcomers then grow a willow-like reputation slowly, with earnings unlocking gradually as peers attest real work over weeks, so an attacker who buys many cheap identities still cannot harvest quickly, and slashing burns the stake of any identity caught coordinating fake attestations.
